coverage_assessment: 18 native search actions, 72 exact query terms, and 433 ordered result headers covered English general and weekly February windows; Kinyarwanda, French and limited Swahili terms; local outlets; official, international and rights-report domains; Gakoni/Gatsibo; student, labor, transport, health, teacher, farmer/vendor and land leads; and January/March boundaries. Search capture extraction retained original ordered headers, refs, URLs and clocks. The scope is open-web discovery, not LexisNexis-equivalent or district-by-district coverage. There are 3 current-unit body opens and 1 prior-unit-only consultation. Three opened pages support one reported Gakoni episode, which remains pending evidence because public-meeting status, 50-person turnout and whether the demand targeted a competent Rwanda state authority (including local police) or government policy is unestablished. One exact UNHCR PDF attempt ended in a tool-level error with unknown HTTP status; it is not recorded as publisher denial. Twenty-three cards remain search_only, including S003 prior-unit-only and S005 technically inaccessible. No absence, exhaustiveness, eligibility approval or official update is claimed.
